takeaways: Azure Databricks is a managed Spark service on Azure that processes data kept in your own storage rather than acting as a database.
Delta Lake adds a transaction log to open Parquet files, giving ACID guarantees, time travel and schema enforcement, while Unity Catalog governs who sees what.
Choose Fabric for dashboard-centric teams already in Power BI and Databricks for large-scale engineering, machine learning or streaming, and often combine both over the same open files.
hook: Spark, lakehouses, notebooks, clusters, Delta Lake and Unity Catalog can feel like a wall of jargon. This episode explains Azure Databricks in plain words for beginners, data teams and decision makers comparing it with Fabric and Synapse. You will understand how the pieces fit together, what drives cost, and when Databricks is the right choice.
